not_observable.case: tests/integration/test_worktrees.py::test_crash_recovery_of_worktrees: the managed checkout directory is removed out of band with shutil.rmtree before worker recover, which then reports its path as orphaned with the row status orphaned; no step can delete files inside a managed checkout (delete acts on the repository's own tree), so the orphan is never created and the orphaned report is not reached.
